title: Map the slop-to-gold verification practices (talk + pstack) onto KRN checks
body:
Evidence: operator link 2026-11-18 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O_zcc6Xl12g (Lauren Tan, 'All Code Is Slop (Except Mine)', AI Engineer, 2026-11-14): 11,000 PRs/month at ~0.5% revert rate via enforceable architecture, lint rules replacing comments, runtime verification with feature maps, formal verification (TLA+, Lean), tokens spent on verification; tooling https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack. Captions returned HTTP 429 twice on 2026-11-18; only the description and chapters were read.
Outcome: a findings file under .krn/runs/research/ maps each practice from the transcript and pstack to KRN (present / missing / task id), with a task created for every missing practice that KRN can check mechanically.
Proof: the findings file lists every chapter of the talk with a present/missing/task verdict.
Files: .krn/runs/research/
